newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania official reserves down 4.9 pct Jan '97.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania official reserves down 4.9 pct Jan '97.

text.p: The Lithuanian central bank said on Thursday that its official reserves decreased 4.9 percent during January 1997 compared to the end of December 1996, slipping to $793.2 million.
The reserves consist of gold worth $62 million, $723.6 million of convertible foreign currencies and holdings of SDRs worth $7.6 million, the bank said in a statement.
The official reserves of the Lithuaninan central bank stood at $834.2 million at the end of December.
It was made up of gold reserves worth $62 million, $762.0 million of convertible foreign currencies and holdings in SDRs which were $10.2 million.
